item.text: The Enrolment sheet has a two-row header (group headers + actual names). Now let me compute the enrolment count properly and cross-check.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel(\"students_2025_26.xlsx\", sheet_name=\"Enrolment\", header=1)
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
print(\"columns:\", list(df.columns))
print(\"total rows:\", len(df))

# Clean: drop fully-empty rows and check for duplicates/validity
df = df.dropna(subset=[\"Student ID\"])
print(\"rows with Student ID:\", len(df))
print(\"unique Student IDs:\", df[\"Student ID\"].nunique())
print(\"unique names:\", df[\"Name\"].nunique())

# Any duplicate IDs?
dups = df[df.duplicated(subset=[\"Student ID\"], keep=False)]
if len(dups):
    print(\"DUPLICATE IDs:\")
    print(dups[[\"Student ID\",\"Name\",\"Class\"]].to_string())

# Enrolment date range
ed = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Enrolment Date\"], format=\"%d/%m/%Y\")
print(\"enrolment date range:\", ed.min().date(), \"->\", ed.max().date())

# Cross-check with other sheets
att = pd.read_excel(\"students_2025_26.xlsx\", sheet_name=\"Attendance\")
print(\"attendance unique Attendance IDs:\", att[\"Attendance ID\"].nunique())
print(\"attendance unique names:\", att[\"Student Name\"].nunique())

assess = pd.read_excel(\"students_2025_26.xlsx\", sheet_name=\"Assessment\", header=1)
print(\"assessment rows:\", len(assess), \"unique Roll No:\", assess.iloc[:,0].nunique())

# Students in enrolment but missing from attendance
missing_att = set(df[\"Name\"]) - set(att[\"Student Name\"])
print(\"enrolled but missing from attendance:\", missing_att)

print(\"\\nBreakdown by class:\")
print(df[\"Class\"].value_counts().sort_index().to_string())
print(\"TOTAL:\", df[\"Student ID\"].nunique())
EOF"
